verdict.rationale: The POS features page offers low-stock notifications triggered by sales-rate thresholds, "powered by Shopify Flow" (docs-20). It also advertises low-code/no-code customization (docs-6). Together these suggest some event-triggered automation, but nothing shows users authoring their own trigger→condition→action rules for POS events. Manager-approval settings and Sidekick's on-request transfers are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented user-defined rule builder for POS events, range of triggers and actions available to POS, any AI-native rule authoring, hands-on or independent corroboration.
